64.title: FAQ
64.content:
Frequently asked questions about our art classes in Hanoi

We’ve collected common questions from our students — whether you're a traveler, expat, or local looking for art classes in Hanoi, this FAQ covers everything from pricing to schedules and materials.

Frequently asked questions about our art classes in Hanoi
1. General Course Info
2. Schedules, Frequency & Flexibility
3. Pricing, Materials & Payment
4. Policies (Refunds, Attendance & Discounts) All classes and packages are non-refundable and non-transferable.
5. Class Types & Special Requests
6. Kids & Teens Classes
7. Home Tuition
8. Inspiration & Local Art in Hanoi
1. General Course Info

Q: I'm a complete beginner. Can I still join your art class?
A: Yes! Many of our students are beginners. Our instructors will guide you throughout the class.

Q: Which course should I take as a beginner?
A: We recommend Pencil Basics 1 — it builds essential skills like line, shape, and shading. It’s the foundation for all other materials.

Q: Are the classes taught in English?
A: Yes. All classes are available in English and Vietnamese.

Q: How long is each session?
A: Adult classes are typically 2 hours, and Life Drawing is 2.5 hours. Kids' classes are 1.5 hours.

Q: Can I try a class before booking the full course?
A: Absolutely. You can book a trial class.

Q: What level am I?
A: Send us your past drawings, or better, book a trial class so we can assess and recommend a course.

2. Schedules, Frequency & Flexibility

Q: I'm only in Hanoi for 1–2 months. Can I take art classes daily?
A: Yes. We offer both structured courses and flexible daily programs.

Q: Can I take multiple classes at the same time?
A: Yes, many students do. We’ll guide you on the best sequence — e.g., Pencil Basics before Charcoal or Oil.

Q: Can I change the schedule midway through a course?
A: Yes. Please let us know at least 1 week in advance so we can adjust your class/teacher accordingly.

Q: Can I pause the course if I need to travel?
A: Yes, you can pause your course if you're traveling and resume at a later date.
Please notify our Admin as early as possible before you leave so we can adjust the schedule.

Q: Can I cancel a class if I’m sick or have a change of plans?
If you're unwell or need to change plans:

  • Please notify our Admin (WhatsApp/Zalo/Email1) at least 24 hours before the scheduled class.
  • We allow you to reschedule the missed class within 7 days with no extra fee.
  • If the rescheduled session doesn’t happen within that time, we’ll charge for the missed class.

🔸 For classes with custom schedules or private 1-on-1 sessions, cancellations made less than 24 hours in advance will be charged in full.

3. Pricing, Materials & Payment

Q: What are the tuition fees?
A: Please see our Pricing page. Most classes start from 400,000VND/session.

Q: Are materials included in the price?
A: Yes. Most beginner classes include all needed tools. Extra items like canvas frames / oil painting medium, may have additional cost.

Q: What materials are used in each class?
A:

  • Pencil Basics: pencils, erasers, paper, measuring tools
  • Charcoal: like above, including vine charcoal
  • Oil Painting: paint tubes, brushes, palette, gloves, oil, apron
  • Sketch: a mix of dry and color media (pastels, colored pencils, markers)

Q: Are there any hidden fees?
A: No, but we’ll inform you if extra materials or changes apply.

Q: How can I pay?
A: Bank transfer, PayPal, or cash. Bank transfer is preferred to reserve your spot.

4. Policies (Refunds, Attendance & Discounts)
All classes and packages are non-refundable and non-transferable.

Rescheduling
Please notify us at least 24 hours before your class to reschedule.

Late cancellations
Cancellations made less than 24 hours before class will normally be counted as a used session.

Emergency exception
Each package includes limited emergency exceptions for unexpected situations (illness or urgent work).
• 6-session package: 1 exception
• 12-session package: 2 exceptions

Package validity
Packages must be completed within their validity period. Unused sessions will expire.
6-session package: valid for 2 months
12-session package: valid for 4 months

Pausing the course
Packages may be paused for travel with at least 2 weeks' notice to Admin.

5. Class Types & Special Requests

Q: Do you offer Life Drawing / Nude Model Sketch classes?
A: Yes. We host regular life drawing / Nude Model Sketch sessions, great for figure drawing and sketching practice.

Q: I want to sketch landscapes or people while traveling. Any class for that?
A: Definitely. Try our life model drawing, sketching courses, or pencil basics.

Q: Do you offer open studio space for independent artists?
A: Yes, we do. Open studio sessions are available for 250,000 VND per 2-hour block. Booking in advance is required.
If you're looking for custom schedules or monthly access, feel free to contact us for rates.

Q: Can I change my class/teacher if I want to?
A: Yes — just let us know and we’ll help match you.

6. Kids & Teens Classes

Q: What age can my child start art classes?
A:

  • Contemporary Art for Kids: usually 7+. For younger children, trial class is still available
  • Pencil Basics 1: 11+ or kids preparing for academic art

Q: How long is a "Contemporary Art for Kids" class?
A: 1.5 hours per session.

7. Home Tuition

Q: Can I choose my tutor for home classes?
A: You may request a tutor, but we’ll recommend the best match depending on the skills you're focusing on.

Q: Can home classes take place in different locations?
A: No — we hold all sessions in a single agreed location.

8. Inspiration & Local Art in Hanoi

Q: Are there any art museums in Hanoi you recommend?
A: Yes! Hanoi has several inspiring museums for art lovers and cultural explorers.
How about joining a museum tour with our Art-Tutor Team?

  • Vietnam National Fine Arts Museum (Bảo tàng Mỹ thuật Việt Nam) – A must-see for anyone learning drawing or painting. This museum features a rich collection of traditional and modern Vietnamese art.
  • Vietnam Museum of Ethnology (Bảo tàng Dân tộc học) – A great place to explore Vietnam’s ethnic diversity, traditional crafts, and folk art.

They’re both perfect for finding artistic inspiration beyond the classroom.
👉 Our Kids Art Courses may include guided visits to the Fine Arts Museum — just ask us!

2951.title: Call for Artists
2951.content:
2025 - "Living Colors" - International Online Exhibition

We’re thrilled to invite you to participate in "Living Colors", an online exhibition celebrating the vibrant expression of life through color! This is your chance to share your unique perspective on the world. Everyone is welcome to submit their work and be part of this exhibition — no experience needed!

Submission Guidelines

    • Theme: Living Colors — celebrate the power, energy, and emotion that color brings to life

    • Medium: Open to all forms — painting, drawing, digital art, mixed media, and more. No AI-generated art — only original works created by you

    • Size: No restrictions — let your creativity run free

    • Submission Fee: Free

    • Deadline for Submissions: 22 June 2025

    • Exhibition Launch & Results Announcement: 29 June 2025

What You’ll Get

    • Selected entries will be featured in the official online exhibition hosted by Art-Tutor

    • Top 3 entries will receive an Art-Tutor certificate and have their artwork printed and exhibited at our studio.

    • Follow us on Facebook and Instagram for updates and announcements!
